title: Limits and Levels Specialist Queue and the Priority Line — Personal Sender Account
content:
For a callback on limits and levels to a Personal Sender Account holder, a level with a dedicated support line is called back from the priority line and a level with a named relationship manager by that manager, and the priority line changes the due date of the callback as the queue step states.

**Queue step.** The queue step reads the account's earlier callbacks:

1. When the most recently requested earlier callback on the account still has a callback due date on or after the callback request date, the new callback waits behind it, and the limits callback window is the counted limits callback window plus half of it, that half rounded up to a whole business day.
2. When no earlier callback is still due and the level the account holds has a dedicated support line, the priority line takes it, and the limits callback window is half the counted limits callback window, rounded up to a whole business day.
3. Otherwise the limits callback window is the counted limits callback window.

The earlier callback read is the one requested most recently on the account, whatever its topic; its callback due date is compared with the callback request date.

## Levels with a dedicated support line

| Level | Dedicated support line | Named relationship manager |
|---|---|---|
| Paloma Starter | no | no |
| Paloma Verified | no | no |
| Paloma Verified Plus | no | no |
| Paloma Enhanced | no | no |
| Paloma Premier | yes | no |
| Paloma Private Client | yes | yes |

## Decision table

| Most recent earlier callback still due on or after the request date | Level has a dedicated support line | Limits callback window |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes or no | the counted window plus half of it, half rounded up |
| no (or no earlier callback) | yes | half the counted window, rounded up |
| no (or no earlier callback) | no | the counted window |

## Worked figures (hypothetical counted windows)

| Counted limits callback window | Waiting behind an earlier callback | Priority line |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 3 plus 2, that is 5 | 2 |
| 4 | 4 plus 2, that is 6 | 2 |
| 5 | 5 plus 3, that is 8 | 3 |
